notes.title: Jugs Bay: Go Go Johanna!
notes.content:
[h1]Jugs Bay Update V.8 is Ready to Play.[/h1][p][/p][p]We’re excited to announce that Update v8 for Jugs Bay is now live! This update puts Johanna in the spotlight with new events, roleplay options, and deeper interactions that expand her story. Alongside that, we’ve reworked systems, improved NPC behavior, and fixed issues to make everything smoother.[/p][p][/p][h2]Highlights[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]More Than Words[/b][/h3][p]Spend time with Johanna in a more personal setting. Share conversations, unlock new interactions, and discover sides of her you’ve never seen before.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993247/fdf3764d9158a17f5473be40a43b1ad184c3171f.png"][/img][/p][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Movie from Asia[/b][/h3][p]Johanna invites you to a double date at the cinema, experience the latest Blockbuster movie from Asia. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993247/856826d0e3847b548d72dbc427335a5e691a4a44.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993247/5a2f0835393514a685a38b47ea3abe9b360a5a0a.png"][/img][/p][h3][/h3][p][/p][h3][b]Midnight Plunge[/b] [/h3][p]A daring late-night adventure under the stars. Will you take the plunge with Johanna in an unforgettable rooftop pool moment?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993247/d18c9c1d5f91f7175d13e8f8c6b1335b4573b6a8.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Final Showdown[/b] [/h3][p]Everything is on the line as Johanna plays her most important game yet. Can her team seize victory, and will you be there to cheer her on? [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993247/42052ca98723a45e623bf7770c5774a2d37ae60e.png"][/img][/p][p]
[/p][h3][b]Big Night[/b] [/h3][p]A night full of music, dancing, and surprises. Celebrate with Johanna and friends, but be ready, the party holds a special ending you won’t want to miss.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993247/772dbe6fa5466e1fcad2833b1f4a9ef7bbf5fd2a.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993247/39d628ecefec4be545fa6eded374d036490d354a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Changelog[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Character Chats & Stats[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated greetings and exits[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaner quest logs for progress tracking[/p][/*][/list][p][b]NPC Actions & Systems[/b][/p][list][*][p]Invite NPCs home for expanded interactions[/p][/*][*][p]Improved event and dialogue behavior[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Items & Locations[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reworked Ticket for Spa Heaven[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked Solar Panel calculation and income generation[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Item handling in activities[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Fixes & Quality of Life[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted gameplay pacing[/p][/*][*][p]General polish for consistency[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Bugs across events and systems[/p][/*][*][p]Fix: Can't go minus into energy[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy this update and please share your feedback with us. Thanks for playing! 
- Taylhappi and Cassandra

notes.title: Jugs Bay v.7.9 Development Update

[/p][h3][b]Changelog[/b]

notes.title: Jugs Bay: City Cassadria
notes.content:

Earn silver to upgrade your gear, with each victory advancing your quest alongside Aniel and unlocking encounters with the realm’s powerful queens.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993247/4bfc6b7c732bff07e7db462b6c4bd45ce9f150de.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Upgrade your Gear[/h2][p]Stop by the Blacksmith's shop to grab powerful new gear to face tougher enemies, Be a good customer to the Blacksmith, and she might reward you with a very special treat.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993247/d532ddf7523c1b3be9e2b30c2f97187aaf960739.png"][/img][/p][h2]Alchemy Lessons[/h2][p]Experiment with Aniel in potion-making sessions, where every brew sparks wild, romantic mishaps.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993247/ca95040e4dee1ad2ce3dfe8de6a2a9e16fc6f8d0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Adventure Awaits[/h2][p]From Cassadria’s capital, embark on quests to treacherous ruins, cursed forests, and beyond.

notes.title: Jugs Bay v0.4 Development Update
notes.content:
[h1]Jugs Bay Update Coming This September[/h1]

Thank you for the positive feedback on our early access release. Your support has been genuinely moving. We're now gearing up for our next major update this September.

This post focuses on technical improvements, and a story & content update post will soon follow.

[h2]Development Progress[/h2]

[h3]New Feature: Placeable Items[/h3]
A new system allows you to place specific items on designated Placement Maps in various locations.

[b]Key Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Grid Placement[/b]: Place, move, and remove items on a grid.
[*] [b]Diverse Item Types[/b]: Purchase a variety of items from different stores, each offering unique benefits:
[*] [b]Profit[/b]: Additional ways to earn income.
[*] [b]Plants[/b]: Grow over time and harvest.
[*] Possibility for [b]Machines [/b]in future updates: Craft advanced products for selling.
[/list]

[h3][b]Locations with Placeable Items[/b][/h3]
[h3]Home Terrace: Balcony Garden[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993247/ae21b392b99ce18cc8414b143e89d3b46d3e8c33.gif[/img]

Transform your terrace into a thriving garden by purchasing and planting various flowers and plants, watching them grow over a specific number of days, harvesting crops for crafting and gifting, and increasing your yield by expanding your garden.


[h3]Home Rooftop: Solar Panel Installation[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993247/02f768eb0150a9a3021fcae433a01abf162e0863.gif[/img]

Purchase and install solar panels on your roof to generate energy that is sold automatically at the end of each day, earning passive income with a lower entry barrier than bank deposits, with future updates potentially allowing installation on lovers homes.



[h3]Memory Gallery Overhaul[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993247/2cca1fd093f0d2f9ea009bf5849bff5cad8da14b.gif[/img]

The improved interface for easier navigation of unlocked scenes now features a updated phone UI with a larger screen, displays the total number of unlocked and unlockable memories, and includes new filters for sorting memories by categories and characters



[h3]Trading / Shop Window Overhaul (In Progress)[/h3]

This feature is still in development. For the latest updates, join our Discord or follow us on Patreon. The overhaul aims to:

[list]
[*] Provide more space for sorting items by usability.
[*] Improve the buying and selling experience.
[*] Improve design for displaying the items and their price.
[/list]


[h3]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/h3]
We've addressed the reported bugs, thanks to everyone who helped identify them.


[b]Hotfixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed: Stuck at Susan Lewd Scene Motorboat and can’t progress.
[*] Fixed: Meet Hitomi Achievement can now also be unlocked when approaching her in the Bakery.
[*] Fixed: Memory Video Preview.
[*] Fixed: Wrong Quest Log updates on playing memories.
[*] Fixed: Crafting will reduce energy by 10 from 11.
[*] Fixed: Random Sauna scene with Kaya which could not be triggered.
[*] Fixed: Various memories not shown properly in the memory gallery.
[/list]


We greatly appreciate everyone who has reported bugs and crashes. Please continue to report any issues via Steam forums or our Discord server.


Thank you and see you next time.

notes.title: New Update: Johanna's Journey - New Chapter
notes.content:
[h1]What's New[/h1]

[list]
[*] New chapter focusing on Johanna's story
[*] Multiple beach events during daytime
[*] Intimate moments at Johanna and Hitomi's home
[*] Soccer match excitement
[*] Sunset beach party with the female soccer team
[*] Opportunity to deepen your relationship with Johanna
[/list]

[h2]Technical Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] Audio issues have been resolved
[*] Indicator if a random scene has already been viewed
[*] Added an indicator for previously viewed random scenes
[*] Improved display of reasons why certain locations are inaccessible
[*] Implemented autosave feature that triggers every 3 minutes
[/list]

[h2]Highlights[/h2]

[h3]Sun, Sand, and Stories[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993247/1cac131d79c0b7666333ae221b56de7b2fe61700.png[/img]
Join Johanna for a relaxing day at the beach. Listen as she opens up about her background and shares her excitement in her current challenges.

[h3]Kickoff to the Past[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993247/8b4d6f64256949d2377eb3d22002181d9e413984.jpg[/img]
Discover Johanna's history as you support her through a pivotal moment in her life.

[h3]Soccer Showdown[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993247/adda3a74077415920b65f9e492fbb8b776e37ffb.png[/img]
Watch Johanna give her all in a high-stakes match. Your support means the world to her

[h3]Sunset Get Together[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993247/7d9c96c762a14c4c5c5bce4f0fe1739b83d78c0b.png[/img]
Join Johanna and her teammates for a memorable evening at Jugs Beach. Bonfires, laughter, and "more" await.

[h3]Breaking the Ice[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44993247/5d7aa835c579d754366606fe7eb6f078a426ee36.jpg[/img]
Take your relationship with Johanna to new heights. Can you earn her complete trust?


[h2]Feedback[/h2]
We're excited for you to experience the new update and would love to get your feedback.
